discoveries.label: A recurring anchor
discoveries.title: The Beatles
discoveries.description: The artist appearing most frequently across the archive, with 13,621 recorded listening moments spanning 11 years.

discoveries.label: After midnight
discoveries.title: 39,824 late-night listening moments
discoveries.description: Recorded between 11:00 PM and 02:00 AM UTC. An observed temporal cluster, not an assumption of mood.

discoveries.label: A repeated daily trace
discoveries.title: Other
discoveries.description: The leading category in recorded transactions, accounting for 5840 receipts (49.2% of all recorded purchases).

discoveries.label: The densest passage
discoveries.title: 2017: High-Density Season
discoveries.description: More traces gathered in 2017 than in any other calendar year: 26,320 listening moments and 1,035 daily transactions.

chapters.title: The Emergence
chapters.description: Early streaming began across Android and Web Player devices with 3,017 music plays, joined in January 2015 by the first recorded household transactions.
chapters.evidence: Spans 2013-07-08 to 2015-12-31. Covers first platform transitions and earliest cash & account records.

chapters.title: The Routine Builds
chapters.description: Daily transportation and food receipts established recurring timing, alongside 6,413 music sessions distributed across weekdays.
chapters.evidence: Year 2016 records consistent transportation tallies (train and auto) alongside active mobile listening.

chapters.title: The High-Density Peak
chapters.description: The most active single year in the archive, recording 26,320 listening moments and 1,035 transactions across all twelve months.
chapters.evidence: Recorded in 2017 with maximum monthly volumes peaking in August (3,396 listens) and October (2,410 listens).

chapters.title: Everyday Rhythms & Rituals
chapters.description: A tightly tracked period of 14,817 listening moments and 676 daily receipts, with frequent recurring Food and Transit entries.
chapters.evidence: Spans 2018-01-01 to 2018-09-20. Dense overlap between household transactions and daily listening.

chapters.title: The Ambient Stream
chapters.description: A continuous listening stretch of 62,198 songs dominated by Android mobile playback and extended album playthroughs.
chapters.evidence: Heavy catalog listening to The Beatles, The Killers, and Radiohead with a 94.7% track completion rate.

chapters.title: The Multi-Facet Archive
chapters.description: Late-era records combining 37,095 music streams through December 2024 with 10,267 card transactions across Indian merchants and transit hubs.
chapters.evidence: Spans January 2022 through December 15, 2024. Includes Augmented India Transactions archive across 2023-2024.

patterns.title: 00:00 gathers the most listening traces
patterns.body: Activity steadily builds toward 0:00 UTC. 25.1% of total playback falls on weekends, showing consistent everyday distribution.
patterns.evidence: Hourly aggregation of 149,860 records across 2013-2024. Peak at 0:00 UTC with 10884 plays.

patterns.title: The Beatles and The Killers lead repeat plays
patterns.body: A 94.7% track completion rate reflects sustained playthroughs rather than frequent skipping. Top platform is android (93.3%).
patterns.evidence: The Beatles: 13,621 plays. The Killers: 6,878 plays. Total skips: 7,869 out of 1,49,860.

patterns.title: Other accounts for 49.2% of transactions
patterns.body: Card is the leading payment channel (79.3%), followed by Saving Bank account 1 (10.3%).
patterns.evidence: 11,878 total transaction records across Household (2,461) and India Transactions (9,417). Total volume: INR 5,19,39,638.

patterns.title: Co-occurring temporal windows across 2015—2024
patterns.body: Throughout overlapping periods, transactions occurred within hours of active music streaming. In accordance with archival integrity, these connections reflect temporal proximity only; no causal relationship is asserted.
patterns.evidence: Temporal intersections between transactions and Spotify streaming across both 2015-2018 and 2023-2024.
